summary: Publish the Fabric adapter as fractal-fabric-adapter with an old-name package and executable bridge

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The primary Nix output and Cargo binary are fractal-fabric-adapter. For one release, packages.st-fabric-adapter refers to the same package and bin/st-fabric-adapter is a relative symlink to bin/fractal-fabric-adapter. Discovery accepts both names, preferring the new name within each searched directory.

downtime.detail: No service, host or runtime changes.

manual.detail: Existing Nix consumers can keep using the old package attribute and binary path during the bridge. Cargo users select --bin fractal-fabric-adapter.

recovery.detail: Identity, adapter journals and state paths are unchanged.
